lines.text: The concept is looked up as a Bar (Planning Code § 102).

NCD-BAYVIEW: the table makes an exception that applies here: a Bar with an ABC Type 42 licence is a conditional use (Planning Code § 737, in force from 2025-04-07 (Ord. 21-25, File No. 240932)).

Third Street Alcohol Restricted Use District: A new on-sale establishment with an ABC Type 42 licence may open in the Bayview Neighborhood Commercial District with Conditional Use. Elsewhere in the district a new Type 42 establishment stays not permitted.
